homes.title: HOME
homes.homesDesc: Manage the DSH_HOME directories recorded by the launcher. A HOME referenced by instances cannot be deleted; deletion only removes the record, never files on disk.
homes.confirmDeleteHome: Delete DSH_HOME "{name}"? Only the launcher record is removed; the directory on disk stays.
homes.browserPickHint: Browser preview cannot open the system directory picker; enter the path manually
homes.homesEmpty: No DSH_HOME yet; add one above

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.profilesDesc: Manage the profiles/ directory of the selected HOME. The default profile lives on instances: one HOME referenced by several instances may have different defaults per instance.
profiles.profileCreatePlaceholder: Enter a new profile name, then create
profiles.profileDeleteConfirm: Delete profile "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
profiles.profilesEmpty: No profiles yet; add one below

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.pluginsDesc: Manage plugins in this profile: enable / disable / uninstall. Plugins mount at instance start; restart the instances referencing this HOME for changes to take effect.
plugins.pluginsPickProfile: Select a profile to view its plugins
plugins.pluginRestartHint: Plugins mount at instance start; restart the instances referencing this HOME for changes to take effect

versions.title: Versions
versions.confirmDeleteVersion: Delete version {version}? Its associated instance will also be removed (data directory preserved).
versions.confirmInstallContent: Download and install DSH {version}? The corresponding instance and dedicated home will be created automatically.
versions.confirmInstallSourceContent: Install DSH {version}? This version is GitHub-only and will be built from source (may take several minutes). The corresponding instance will be created automatically.

settings.title: Settings
settings.minimizeToTray: Minimize to system tray when closing the main window

terminal.label: External terminal
terminal.hint: The "Open terminal" button on home instance cards opens the terminal selected here, injecting DSH_HOME and the instance env and entering the instance HOME directory.

logLevel.label: Log level
logLevel.hint: Runtime logs go to logs/latest.log in the data directory; the previous log is rotated on every launch.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.desc: Use these shortcuts inside the app window to navigate quickly; the macOS native menu uses the same bindings, driven by backend menu events.
shortcuts.note: Use ⌘ on macOS and Ctrl on Windows / Linux; ⌘/Ctrl+R only refreshes in-app state and never reloads the page; ordinary editing keys inside inputs are never hijacked. Rows marked "Native" are handled directly by the system menu and work inside the app too.

proxy.title: Proxy
proxy.enabledHint: The launcher's own network requests (plugin market, version downloads, news, update checks, etc.) go through this proxy.
proxy.noProxyHint: Comma-separated hosts / addresses that bypass the proxy.
proxy.applyDshHint: When enabled, launching an instance injects HTTP_PROXY / HTTPS_PROXY / NO_PROXY, overriding the instance's environment variables; instances that are already running must be restarted for this to take effect.

update.title: Launcher updates
update.channelHint: The dev channel includes pre-releases; the release channel checks stable versions only (pre-releases are ignored).
update.upToDate: You are on the latest version

dataDir.title: Data directory
dataDir.desc: The launcher's data directory (config, logs, versions and HOME directories)
dataDir.hint: The launcher's data directory (config, logs, versions and HOME directories)

environment.title: Environment
environment.desc: The toolchain the launcher resolved and bound to. Instances and plugins use these paths.

instanceEdit.name: Instance name
instanceEdit.dedicatedHome: ✦ New dedicated DSH_HOME for this instance
instanceEdit.dedicatedHomeHint: A dedicated directory will be created on save: {path}
instanceEdit.defaultProfileHint: Follows the DSH_HOME above: confirm the default again after switching HOME.
instanceEdit.iconUrlHint: Paste an https:// image URL, or pick a local image
instanceEdit.iconHint: Local images are center-cropped to 1:1 and stored in the instance directory; the launcher icon is the default and is never exported
instanceEdit.envDesc: Runtime environment variables injected when the instance starts; they override same-named system variables. DSH_HOME is injected by the launcher and cannot be overridden.
instanceEdit.envKeyReserved: DSH_HOME is managed by the launcher and cannot be overridden
instanceEdit.portHint: Port the web UI listens on; empty or outside 1-65535 (e.g. 0 / -1 / 65536) binds a random port. A running instance needs a restart to pick it up.
instanceEdit.portSavedRandom: Saved; a random port will be used
instanceEdit.preserveSymlinksHint: Only needed when the profile depends on a link:-ed plugin. With it on, Node loads one package through several distinct paths, so dsh-app-boot is loaded more than once and every DSH settings write fails — the Web UI stays stuck on the internal-testing notice and the settings page cannot save. Restart the instance after changing it.
instanceEdit.filesHint: Open this instance's DSH_HOME directory, or reveal its runtime log in Finder
